policy.selection_rule: Latest eligible vintage with publishTime <= cutoff containing forecast records for target delivery date
policy.aggregation_method: arithmetic mean of two half-hourly actuals per clock hour

metrics.mae: Mean Absolute Error in MW: mean(|forecast - actual|)
metrics.rmse: Root Mean Squared Error in MW: sqrt(mean((forecast - actual)^2))
metrics.bias: Signed Mean Error in MW: mean(forecast - actual), positive = overforecast, negative = underforecast
metrics.wape: Weighted Absolute Percentage Error in %: sum(|forecast - actual|) / sum(actual) * 100
metrics.coverage: valid matched intervals / expected intervals (ratio 0.0 to 1.0)
